title: Pumpkin Swirl Bread
description: This quick pumpkin swirl bread recipe features ribbons of sweetened cream cheese throughout a cinnamon- and nutmeg-spiced loaf, for an autumnal treat.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease and flour a 9x5-inch loaf pan.
Beat ¼ cup sugar, cream cheese, and 1 egg in a large bowl with an electric mixer until smooth and creamy. Set aside.

Combine remaining 1 ½ cups sugar, flour, baking soda, cinnamon, salt, and nutmeg in a separate bowl. Combine remaining 1 egg, pumpkin, butter, and water in a separate bowl; stir in flour mixture until moistened.

Reserve 2 cups pumpkin batter. Pour remaining batter into the prepared pan; pour cream cheese mixture over top. Top with reserved 2 cups pumpkin batter; cut through batter several times with a knife for a swirl effect.

Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into center comes out clean, about 70 minutes. Cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then remove from the pan, and transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
